title: Saturn Has a Six-Sided Storm Wider Than Earth

scenes.text: Saturn has a six-sided storm bigger than Earth.
Each side of the hexagon is about 14,500 kilometres long, longer than Earth is wide.
The whole thing is about 30,000 kilometres across.
Winds inside race around at about 200 miles an hour.
Voyager first spotted it in 1981, and it was still there when Cassini returned.
A perfect hexagon, sitting on top of a planet.

description:
Saturn's north pole has a hexagon-shaped jet stream with sides about 14,500 kilometres long.
It was first seen by Voyager in 1981, and Cassini saw it again decades later.
Why do you think it has six sides?
first_comment: A six-sided storm on Saturn. What shape do you wish a storm was?
